text: At its meeting held on July 28 and 29, 2020, City Council adopted Item NY16.15 without amendment. Part 1.c. of Council's decision requires the owner to register the beautification agreement on title to the property and to provide proof of registration to the City Solicitor. Since the owner has already submitted their beautification plan to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor, this condition is no longer necessary to achieve the requirements in the beautification agreement and can be deleted. Hydro One and/or Infrastructure Ontario commits to do other walkway and landscaping improvements as set out in the letter (December 22, 2020) from Hydro One to Councillor Mike Colle. In order to ensure Hydro One and/or Infrastructure Ontario is held accountable to honour their commitment, City Council is requested to add a recommendation to that effect.
